correctness.rationale: For any fixed omitted coordinate, exact block minimization gives rank-one energy residual e_j e_j^T/(H^{-1})_{jj}. The worst conditional expectation is lambda_max of normalized inverse-Hessian Gram scaled by omission probabilities. The unit fixed Rayleigh witness gives a universal bound 1/R, attained by positive Perron eigenvector at the inverse-row-sum law; equality forces the same law by matrix invertibility. On a 3-by-3 star the signed Gram is explicit, the volume omission weights follow principal-minor determinants, and the top symmetric-mode root has strictly negative derivative between volume and uniform weights. The unique optimizer is separate. Derivatives at s=1 give a sharp 4/3 decrement limit. Algebraic proof covers all stated real parameters; 62 supplementary symbolic/spectral checks replay.

originality.rationale: The exact signed inverse-Hessian Gram minimax sufficient condition is an all-dimensional largest-eigenvalue complement-block statement; the principal new numerical observation is the strict volume-sampling versus uniform reversal for every three-variable star, with a sharp factor 4/3 in the near-singular expected decrement. The 2019 motivating volume-sampling paper defines this exact pair law and proves convergence rates, but does not present this counterordering or its sharp limit. A preexisting three-variable pair-optimality result covers the special star optimal weights, which are used as known comparisons rather than counted as newly discovered. The distinct singleton-coordinate inverse-positive theorem optimizes a smallest eigenvalue, not this complement-block largest eigenvalue. Residual equivalence risk in saturated spectral design is explicitly retained.
residual_risks: An older saturated E-optimal design, Perron matrix diagonal-scaling, or sketch-and-project treatment may give an equivalent all-dimensional signed-Gram lemma.
A previously recorded three-variable pair-sampling result already proves its special optimal law; no originality is assigned to that subformula.
The strict volume-uniform ordering or 4/3 decrement limit could occur in an unexamined appendix or alternative terminology; absence from inspected material is not proof of precedence.
Exact one-step worst-direction expectation does not determine the precise multi-step mean-square exponent or implementation time.
